required_for_final_qualification: at least one repeat stream with exact-byte determinism PASS
consumer_outputs: determinism.json when repeated streams are supplied
triage.json when conformance is not PASS

authority_rules.native_provenance: S3-Benchmarks validate_s3ir2_v2_native_provenance.py recomputes candidate-source, candidate-binary, fixture, and stream hashes

promotion_rule: A completeness bit alone never promotes a lane. Final laboratory qualification requires structural PASS, validated native provenance PASS, S3 strict semantic conformance PASS, and deterministic repeated stream bytes. S3-Benchmarks still has no authority to mutate or promote the S3 compiler.
mutation_rule: The consumer is read-only with respect to the S3 checkout and candidate artifacts.
